assertions.message: Power Apps selector coverage includes acute, ED, MH, community MH, subacute, outpatients, adjusted NWAU, HAC, and AHR.
Every selector declares states for 2013 through 2026.
Source-available, shadow, planned, blocked, and unavailable states are displayable but not enabled for calculation submission.
ED selector records historical variant surfaces for UDG, AECC, and emergency-service URG/ES without creating separate runnable operations.
